SELECT d.drink_id, d.drink_category_id, d.drink_name, dd.size, TO_CHAR(dd.price, 'FM999,999,999') || 'đ' AS price, d.image_url, CASE WHEN d.status = 1 THEN 'Đang bán' WHEN d.status = 0 THEN 'Ngừng bán' ELSE 'Không xác định' END AS status, d.is_deleted FROM drinks AS d JOIN drink_details AS dd ON d.drink_id = dd.drink_id JOIN drink_categories AS dc ON d.drink_category_id = dc.drink_category_id
d.is_deleted = false AND dc.is_deleted = false
